lines.en: I inch my way across the leaf

lines.zh: 我的身体一节一节往前
lines.en: My body moves forward segment by segment
I grip the leaf edge with my prolegs
I chew a path across the leaf
I lift my front half to test the way

lines.zh: 我的条纹跟着身体一伸一缩
lines.en: My stripes stretch and shrink with my body
I crawl over the leaf vein
I crawl slowly, but never stop
My feet cling to the leaf surface

lines.zh: 我绕过一片被啃过的缺口
lines.en: I go around a chewed-out gap
I move along the underside of the leaf
I follow the vein in a straight line

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一节节收起来
lines.en: My tail segments draw in one by one

lines.zh: 我从一片叶爬到另一片
lines.en: I crawl from one leaf onto another
I test the leaf edge with my front half
I stretch my body long and pull it short
I stop in the middle of a leaf
My body lies along the leaf vein
I lift my head and do nothing
The edge of the leaf is beneath me
I contract once, then stretch out
I am very quiet this daylight

lines.zh: 我的条纹在阳光里很清楚
lines.en: My stripes show clearly in the sun
I turn in place on the leaf

lines.zh: 我听到风吹叶子的声音
lines.en: I hear the wind in the leaves
I slowly settle myself down
I lie on the leaf soaking up sun

lines.zh: 我一动不动地贴着叶脉
lines.en: I lie motionless along the vein
You are blocking my light

lines.zh: 我这边只有这一片叶子
lines.en: I have only this one leaf here
Look if you must, do not touch me
I raise my front half to look at you
I am too close to the leaf edge

lines.zh: 你手别碰叶柄，我全靠它
lines.en: Keep your hands off the stem; my life hangs on it.
I am much smaller than you

lines.zh: 我这条命就系在这几片叶上
lines.en: My whole life is tied to these few leaves.

lines.zh: 你离得太远，我连你鞋尖都碰不到
lines.en: You're so far off I can't even reach your boot.
You stand so high I cannot see clearly
My body was pressed

lines.zh: 我被撞得蜷成一圈，条纹挤在一起
lines.en: I curl into a ring, my stripes squashed together.
Leaf is stained with my fluid
I shift segment by segment

lines.zh: 我的一条腹足抬不起来
lines.en: One of my prolegs will not lift
That knocked me off
I writhe on the ground

lines.zh: 我离开叶子就活不了太久
lines.en: I cannot live long off a leaf
I try to crawl toward the leaf edge
Even lifting my head is hard
Is that a leaf you hold

lines.zh: 你手里的一片我看得懂
lines.en: That leaf in your hand, I understand it
I twist my front half that way
I inched a little closer
This leaf looks very tender
I eat only leaves from trees

lines.zh: 我只认得叶子，别的都咬不动
lines.en: I only know leaves; nothing else will do.

lines.zh: 你放在叶子上，我就过去
lines.en: Put it on a leaf and I will come

lines.zh: 我的身体已经饿得发软
lines.en: My body is soft with hunger

lines.zh: 你再近一点我就能碰到
lines.en: A little closer and I can reach

lines.zh: 你碰了叶子，我晃了一下
lines.en: You touched the leaf and I wobbled
I gripped tighter

lines.zh: 这一下差点把我推下去
lines.en: That nearly pushed me off
I coil into a tight little ring
You tilted my leaf
I slowly crawl to the other side

lines.zh: 我们撞到了一起，你很硬
lines.en: We bumped, and you are hard
I retreated to the middle of the leaf
That little disturbance is a lot for me
I hold the vein and do not let go
I am not at that stage yet
I am only eating leaves
That is very far from me
I need to grow first

lines.zh: 我身上只有条纹，没到找伴的时候
lines.en: I'm all stripes, nowhere near mate-seeking age.
I pulled my head back
I cannot speak to this
I know only leaves

lines.zh: 我连蛹都还没结，先吃叶子
lines.en: I haven't even spun a chrysalis yet; leaves first.
I will not shift an inch
I lift my head and look at it
I can eat this leaf
I bite it and drag it closer

lines.zh: 你放下的东西都很好吃
lines.en: What you set down is all tasty
I shift myself over to it
This is better than the leaf edge
I hold it down with my front half
I slowly start to nibble
This will last me a day
I left nothing
The leaf is moving in the wind
I found another one
My front half has lifted
There is a greener patch over there
Should I go
That direction is a little far
First I will finish this stretch
I stretch my head that way
The leaf is not far
I have begun inching along
I work over segment by segment
A leaf vein lies between
I go around that gap
My body is a little dry
I stop and rest a moment
This way is farther than I thought
I crawl on forward
I am a short stretch away
This back part is empty
I am nearly there
I butt it with my head
I bite its edge
I press my whole body onto it

lines.zh: 我推了你一下，跟推叶脉差不多
lines.en: I shove you about as hard as I'd shove a leaf vein.
I only wanted to push it away
I draw back and keep eating

lines.zh: 我张嘴咬你的指尖，牙太小
lines.en: I bite your fingertip, and my jaws are too small.
I push with my front half
I squeezed it aside
I destroyed nothing
I have not long been out of the egg

lines.zh: 这片平原的叶子够我吃
lines.en: The leaves on these plains are enough for me
I have found my first leaf
I slowly climb onto it
My body is still very soft
I look up at the tree
When the wind blows I hold tighter
I will grow up right here
I will not go far

lines.zh: 我的条纹已经很清楚了
lines.en: My stripes are already clear

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的身体就干了
lines.en: Fire dried my body out
I fell from the leaf to the ground

lines.zh: 水把我贴在叶面上，动不了
lines.en: The water pressed me to the leaf, I could not move

lines.zh: 气浪把我和叶子一起掀开
lines.en: The blast threw me and the leaf apart

lines.zh: 一根细东西穿过我的身体
lines.en: Something thin passed through my body

lines.zh: 那股术力让我的身体一抽一抽
lines.en: That magic made my body twitch
I have stayed off leaves too long
The flash came through the leaf to me
The leaf and the ground are both gone
